title: South of the Border Swap
summary:
South of the Border Swap
The Potential Impact of a US - Mexican Oil Exchange As geographical neighbors, the United States and Mexico have a long and mutually beneficial energy relationship. For many years, Mexico has been one of the top suppliers of crude oil to the US, which has reciprocated by sending significant volumes of refined products to Mexico. Mexico is also the largest net importer of US natural gas.
